title: Complete endpoints baseline columns before endpoint upserts

phases.objective: Make the canonical endpoints baseline compatible with all endpoint identity, governance, schema, and runtime-binding columns used before and after the first live replay upserts.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact local checkout applies schema.sql and the migration chain ordered by numeric prefix with filename tie-breaker in disposable MariaDB.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Endpoint seed/upsert migrations can write endpoint_title and the full runtime governance/schema contract without unknown-column failures, and endpoint registry consumers can read the same fields.
steps: The canonical endpoints baseline defines identity, title/provider, execution/dependency/logging metadata, category/review/legacy flags, request/schema capability flags, runtime binding profile, access flags, and writeback scope.
The manifest declares the expanded required_endpoints_baseline_columns contract.
The generator validates every required endpoints column before disposable MariaDB replay and includes the contract in plan evidence.
Migration 068 and later endpoint registrations can insert/update the full contract deterministically without provider calls or secret payloads.
Runtime endpoint registry loaders can select endpoint_title, provider_family, runtime_binding_profile, schema_json, and governance fields from the baseline.
Production and provider mutation remain forbidden.
assertions: schema.sql contains every required endpoints baseline column.
Migration 068 exercises the widened endpoint contract and is replay-compatible.
Migration 1023 exercises dependency, logging, runtime-binding, access, and schema columns.
The generator fails closed when any required endpoint baseline column is absent.
Regression tests cover migration ordering and plan evidence.
No plaintext secret or external mutation is introduced.
